# Aqara Developer
> Cloud API, Studio local API, and data model documentation for developers integrating with Aqara.

## Recommended starting points
- Overview: https://docs.aqara.com/docs/aqara-developer/introduction
- Introduction: https://docs.aqara.com/docs/aqara-developer/aiot-api/introduction
- Introduction: https://docs.aqara.com/docs/aqara-developer/data-export-api/introduction
- Core Concepts: https://docs.aqara.com/docs/aqara-developer/aqara-data-model-specification/core-concepts
